children: This is the gallery subpage for the Kingpin. It contains images of every skin, descriptions, skin information and more.
Pale skin, black hair, white shirt, black coat, black glove, black pants, golden watch and black shoes.
Wields a Luger P08 to attack enemies.
Now wields a Uzi submachine gun.

White fur around neck.

Fedora and vest are now white with gold buttons, gloves are now maroon, shoes are now brown with gold laces and coat and pants are now dark brown.

Face is now smiling.

Now wields a Desert Eagle.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000022-QINU`"''"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000023-QINU`"'

White fur below coat.

Gloves and pants are now red and shoes are now slightly maroon.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000024-QINU`"''"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000025-QINU`"'

Gold monocle, red details on sleeves.

Coat, shirt and pants now have golden accents.

Now dual wields golden Desert Eagles.

Maroon fur around neck.

Shirt now has long sleeves and tie is now black again, watch is now silver.

Face is now smirking.

Now wields an AK-47.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000027-QINU`"'

Coat replaced with tattered black trench coat.

Vest and pants are now maroon.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000028-QINU`"'

Black head piece fedora.

Gloves are now maroon, sleeves have stripes on them and pants are meant to have red stripes on them, though the pants are hidden by the previous pants.

Now dual wields golden AK-47s.
